```{r acute graphs}
#old colours "1" = "#018080", "2" = "#89138A"


xyplotting <- function(df, negx, posx, negy, posy){  
  # Create base plot with gridlines and labels
  gg <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2_avg_upfc, y = log2_avg_downfc)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    xlab("log2FCup") + ylab("log2FCdown") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
    #xlim(-1.5, 2.6) + ylim(-1.5, 2.6)
    xlim(negx, posx) + ylim(negy, posy)
 
   # Plot points for directionfc = 1 first (bottom layer)
  gg <- gg +
    geom_point(data = df %>% filter(directionfc == "OTHER"), 
               aes(color = factor(directionfc)), 
               shape = 16, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)

  # Then plot points for directionfc = 3 (middle layer)
  gg <- gg +
    geom_point(data = df %>% filter(directionfc == "PROP"), 
               aes(color = factor(directionfc)), 
               shape = 16, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)

  # Finally, plot points for directionfc = 2 (top layer)
  gg <- gg +
    geom_point(data = df %>% filter(directionfc == "INV"), 
               aes(color = factor(directionfc)), 
               shape = 16, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)

  # Custom color scale
  gg <- gg + scale_color_manual(values = c("PROP" = "#ff0000", "INV" = "#3cb9fa", "OTHER" = "grey"))

  #gg <- gg %>% ggMarginal(type = "violin", size = 10, fill = species, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
  
return(list(ggplot = gg, df_data = df))
}


mphosshift <- xyplotting(mphosavs, -1, 2, -1, 1.1)
hphosshift <- xyplotting(hphosavs, -1, 2, -1, 1.1)
mprotshift <- xyplotting(mprotavs, -1.5, 2.6, -1.5, 2.1)
hprotshift <- xyplotting(hprotavs, -1.5, 2.6, -1.5, 2.1)
```

```{r acute statistics MANOVA}
#MANOVA test
# Step 1: Add a species column to each dataframe
mprotavs$species <- "mouse"
hprotavs$species <- "human"
mphosavs$species <- "mouse"
hphosavs$species <- "human"

# Step 2: Combine the two dataframes
dfprot_combined <- rbind(mprotavs, hprotavs)
dfphos_combined <- rbind(mphosavs, hphosavs)

# Step 3: Perform MANOVA
# Use log2_avg_upfc as the X variable and log2_avg_downfc as the Y variable
manovaprot_result <- manova(cbind(log2_avg_upfc, log2_avg_downfc) ~ species, data = dfprot_combined)
manovaphos_result <- manova(cbind(log2_avg_upfc, log2_avg_downfc) ~ species, data = dfphos_combined)

# Step 4: Check summary statistics for the MANOVA test
summary(manovaprot_result)
summary(manovaphos_result)


```

```{r acute centroids}

# Function to calculate centroid
calculate_centroid <- function(df) {
  x_centroid <- mean(df$log2_avg_upfc, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_centroid <- mean(df$log2_avg_downfc, na.rm = TRUE)
  return(c(x_centroid, y_centroid))
}

calculate_centroid(mprotavs)
calculate_centroid(hprotavs)

# Updated xyplotting function
xyplotting <- function(df, negx, posx, negy, posy){
  
  # Calculate centroid
  centroid <- calculate_centroid(df)

  # Create base plot with gridlines and labels
  gg <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2_avg_upfc, y = log2_avg_downfc)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    xlab("log2FCup") + ylab("log2FCdown") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
    xlim(negx, posx) + ylim(negy, posy)
  
  # Plot points for directionfc = 1 first (bottom layer)
  gg <- gg +
    geom_point(data = df %>% filter(directionfc == "OTHER"), 
               aes(color = factor(directionfc)), 
               shape = 16, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)
  
  # Then plot points for directionfc = 3 (middle layer)
  gg <- gg +
    geom_point(data = df %>% filter(directionfc == "PROP"), 
               aes(color = factor(directionfc)), 
               shape = 16, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)
  
  # Finally, plot points for directionfc = 2 (top layer)
  gg <- gg +
    geom_point(data = df %>% filter(directionfc == "INV"), 
               aes(color = factor(directionfc)), 
               shape = 16, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5)
  
  # Custom color scale
  gg <- gg + scale_color_manual(values = c("PROP" = "#ff0000", "INV" = "#3cb9fa", "OTHER" = "grey"))
  
  # Add centroid to the plot
  gg <- gg + geom_point(aes(x = centroid[1], y = centroid[2]), color = "black", size = 3/.pt, shape = 19)
  
  # Add covariance ellipse using stat_ellipse if you want
  # gg <- gg + stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", 
                       #   geom = "polygon", fill = "#bbbbbb50")
  
  return(list(ggplot = gg, df_data = df))
}
```

```{r acute phos vs prot mouse vectors}

# Convert the mouse and human coordinates to vectors (Euclidean distance)
mouseprot_magnitude <- sqrt(rowSums(mprotavs[, c("log2_avg_upfc", "log2_avg_downfc")]^2))
mousephos_magnitude <- sqrt(rowSums(mphosavs[, c("log2_avg_upfc", "log2_avg_downfc")]^2))

# Compare the magnitudes using a Wilcoxon test
magnitude_test <- wilcox.test(mouseprot_magnitude, mousephos_magnitude)

# View the test result
print(magnitude_test)

# Create a dataframe for plotting
magnitude_df <- data.frame(
  species = c(rep("Mouse\n proteome", length(mouseprot_magnitude)), rep("Mouse\n phosphoproteome", length(mousephos_magnitude))),
  magnitude = c(mouseprot_magnitude, mousephos_magnitude)
)

vectorannotation_text <- paste(
    "Wilcoxon p-value:", signif(magnitude_test$p.value, 3), 
    "\nMedian Proteome", ":", round(median(mouseprot_magnitude), 3),
    "\nMedian Phosphoproteome", ":", round(median(mousephos_magnitude), 3)
  )

# Plot the magnitudes
mousevectors <- ggplot(magnitude_df, aes(x = species, y = magnitude)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(y = "Vector Magnitude", x = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7), axis.title = element_text(size = 7)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = Inf, label = vectorannotation_text, vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 7/.pt)

ggsave(plot=mousevectors, "./Plots/mprot_v_mphos_fcvectors.pdf", width = 1.5, height = 1.5, dpi = 300)

```

```{r adaptation}

hphoshvl <- read.csv("./Processed data/3human_phos_SL(prot)norm_hvl.csv")
mphoshvl <- read.csv("./Processed data/3mouse_phos_SL(prot)norm_hvl.csv")
hprothvl <- read.csv("./Processed data/3human_prot_SL(prot)norm_hvl.csv")
mprothvl <- read.csv("./Processed data/3mouse_prot_SL(prot)norm_hvl.csv")


# Function to calculate fold changes and plot density
# Function to calculate fold changes, perform Wilcoxon test, and plot densities
compare_fold_changes <- function(df1, low_prefix1, high_prefix1, species1,
                                 df2, low_prefix2, high_prefix2, species2) {
  
  # Calculate fold changes for the first dataframe
  df1 <- df1 %>%
    mutate(species = species1)
  
  # Calculate fold changes for the second dataframe
  df2 <- df2 %>%
    mutate(species = species2)
  
  # Combine the two dataframes
  combined_df <- bind_rows(df1, df2)
  
  # Perform Wilcoxon test on average fold change between the two species
  wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(log2_avg_high_low ~ species, data = combined_df)
  p_value <- signif(wilcox_result$p.value, 3)
  
  # Calculate medians for each species
  medians <- combined_df %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    summarise(median_fold_change = median(log2_avg_high_low, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # Create the density plot
  gg <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = log2_avg_high_low, fill = species)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5, colour = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    labs(x = "Log2 FC", y = "Density") +
    xlim(-1.5, 1.5) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ff8000", "#333333")) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 7), axis.ticks.length=unit(.05, "in"))
  
  # Add p-value and medians as annotation on the plot
  annotation_text <- paste(
    "Wilcoxon p-value:", p_value, 
    "\nMedian", species1, ":", round(medians$median_fold_change[medians$species == species1], 3),
    "\nMedian", species2, ":", round(medians$median_fold_change[medians$species == species2], 3)
  )
  
  gg <- gg + annotate("text", x = 1, y = Inf, label = annotation_text, vjust = 1.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 7/.pt)
  
  return(list(ggplot = gg, df_data = combined_df))
}


comparephoshvl <- compare_fold_changes(hphoshvl, "Hlow", "Hhigh", "Human", 
                     mphoshvl, "Mlow", "Mhigh", "Mouse")
ggsave(plot=comparephoshvl$ggplot, "./Plots/comparephoshvl.pdf", width = 1.5, height = 1, dpi = 300)


compareprothvl <- compare_fold_changes(hprothvl, "Hlow", "Hhigh", "Human", 
                     mprothvl, "Mlow", "Mhigh", "Mouse")
ggsave(plot=compareprothvl$ggplot, "./Plots/compareprothvl.pdf", width = 1.5, height = 1, dpi = 300)



#to only compare p<0.05
hphoshvlp <- hphoshvl %>%
  filter(pVal < 0.05)
mphoshvlp <- mphoshvl %>%
  filter(P.value < 0.05)


comparephoshvlp0.05 <- compare_fold_changes(hphoshvlp, "Hlow", "Hhigh", "Human", 
                     mphoshvlp, "Mlow", "Mhigh", "Mouse")
```

```{r pathway highlighting heat}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

path <- read.csv("pathway_genes.csv")

hprotavs_path <- hprotavs %>%
  inner_join((path %>% filter(category == "heat") %>% 
                mutate(main_gene = toupper(main_gene))), 
     by = "main_gene")

mprotavs_path <- mprotavs %>%
  inner_join((path %>% filter(category == "heat") %>% 
                mutate(main_gene = str_to_title(main_gene))), 
     by = "main_gene")


xynamesplotting <- function(df, negx, posx, negy, posy){  
  # Create base plot with gridlines and labels
  gg <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2_avg_upfc, y = log2_avg_downfc, label = main_gene)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    xlab("log2FCup") + ylab("log2FCdown") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
    #xlim(-1.5, 2.6) + ylim(-1.5, 2.6)
    xlim(negx, posx) + ylim(negy, posy)
 
  gg <- gg +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) + 
    geom_text_repel(size = 2, segment.size = 0.5/.pt, max.overlaps=100, point.padding = 0.5/.pt, force = 2, min.segment.length = 0)

return(list(ggplot = gg, df_data = df))
}

hvlnamesplotting <- function(df){  
  # Create base plot with gridlines and labels
  gg <- ggplot(df, aes(x = main_gene, y = fold_change)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    xlab("") + ylab("log2FC") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    ylim(-2.7,1) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 7))

return(list(ggplot = gg, df_data = df))
}

     by = "main_gene")


```
